text:
ada: Free grab from Soma desk — clearing out my tech bubble. Box with: 4x USB-C 65W bricks (unbranded, all work), a bunch of unused Cat6a cables (2m/5m), 1x unopened Thunderbolt 3 dock, and a 34" Acer ultrawide monitor (has a tiny dead pixel near bottom-right, barely noticeable). Pickup only, today or tomorrow between 10am–4pm. DM me to claim. :sparkles:

samir: interested in the dock — can swing by at 3pm. DMing now.

nina: can i take the monitor? i don't mind one dead pixel, have a stand already. no car but can Uber. would love it. :pray:

lisa: i could use some cat6a cables for the office bench. if someone can bring me 2x 2m cables, i can pick up the rest later.

ada (ops-bot): Reminder: please follow the office pickup guidelines — leave items labeled with your name and desk location at Reception if you need us to hold them for >24h. https://intranet/reception-pickups

samir: grabbed the dock — thanks ada! left a quick thumbs-up reaction. :thumbsup:

ada: @nina, ada said she can hold the monitor until 4:30 if you can make it today.

nina: running a bit late, can do 4:15. i'll be wearing a red jacket.

lisa: if there's still a 65W brick after samir/others, i can take one for my travel kit. otherwise i'll grab the cables.

ada: one 65W brick reserved for @lisa, one more available. i'll label the box and leave it at Reception with a sticky note: "random - ada - claims: samir (dock), nina (monitor), lisa (1 brick + cables)"

devex: quick PSA — anyone bringing electronics to Reception, please wipe any personal auth tokens from devices and remove keychains. we had a lost key once and it's a pain to reconcile.

nina: at Reception now in a red jacket, picking up monitor. thanks again ada! :heart:

ada: leaving an extra ethernet cable in the bin by the bench for anyone who needs it. first come first serve. enjoy! :recycle:
